connector.name: Just Signal
connector.registryDescription: Keyless MCP for Just Signal: live quotes, report publishing, scorecard, and Chophouse panel grades.
connector.summary: Hosted at ou-reports.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package just-signal-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.ou-reports, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
